record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Let BΩ be the family of countable Borel ω-covers. Is it consistent that every set of reals satisfying Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) is countable?

evidence.quote: Is Borel’s Conjecture for Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) consistent?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in ZFC. For a set of reals $X$, a countable family $\mathcal{U}$ of Borel subsets of $X$ is called a Borel $\omega$-cover of $X$ if $X \notin \mathcal{U}$ and for every finite set $F \subseteq X$ there exists $U \in \mathcal{U}$ with $F \subseteq U$. Let $\mathcal{B}_\Omega$ denote the family of all countable Borel $\omega$-covers of $X$.

A set of reals $X$ satisfies the selection principle $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B}_\Omega, \mathcal{B}_\Omega)$ if for every sequence $(\mathcal{U}_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of elements of $\mathcal{B}_\Omega$ there exist finite subfamilies $\mathcal{F}_n \subseteq \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\bigcup_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \mathcal{F}_n \in \mathcal{B}_\Omega$.

Question: Is it consistent with ZFC that every set of reals $X$ satisfying $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B}_\Omega, \mathcal{B}_\Omega)$ is countable?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted search did not return a definitive resolution of the consistency question for the Borel-conjecture-type statement specific to $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B}_\Omega, \mathcal{B}_\Omega)$. Related Borel-conjecture variants (classical Borel Conjecture, dual Borel Conjecture, $\gamma$-Borel Conjecture) have been shown consistent, but no direct confirmation or refutation for this particular selection principle was located.

status_evidence.title: The gamma-Borel conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Consistency of a Borel-conjecture-style statement for the gamma-property.
status_evidence.claim: Related variants of Borel's Conjecture for selection-principle classes have been studied; consistency proven for the gamma case, but no specific result for Sfin(B_Omega, B_Omega) was located.

status_evidence.title: On the consistency of Borel's Conjecture (Laver)
status_evidence.snippet: Laver's proof that the classical Borel Conjecture is consistent with ZFC.
status_evidence.claim: Original Borel Conjecture is consistent; analogous question for Sfin(B_Omega,B_Omega) not addressed here.
